pullRequest.title: Show the milling fee on the milling-day schedule
pullRequest.body:
Each slot on the schedule now shows what the grower owes for milling, so the volunteer can take it when they arrive instead of working it out on the back of an envelope.

The committee's charges: 40p a kilo for the first 50 kg, 30p a kilo for everything over that, £5.00 minimum. So 60 kg is £20.00 for the first 50 kg plus £3.00 for the other 10, £23.00 in all. Fees are worked out in whole pence.

Member discounts stay at the till as they are now: the treasurer checks the membership list there, so the schedule always shows the standard fee.
pullRequest.author: sam
